newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs end flat in featureless trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs end flat in featureless trade.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen and Japanese government bond (JGB) futures crept to a steady finish after an uninspired session on Thursday.
March Euroyen ended unchanged against its CME close at 99.07 on low volume of 5,800 lots. Near-term support is seen at 99.03/05, with resistance at 99.12.
"It's possible that outside factors like the U.S. PPI and CPI will affect Euroyen because there's no domestic news affecting it right now," said a Japanese bank dealer.
March Eurodollars finished at 93.78 against their CME close at 93.77.

December JGBs ended at 121.26 against their opening 121.32. A trader with a European futures house said rumours that a Japanese institution was short of about 80 billion yen worth of cash JGBs ahead of delivery had given the bond futures a positive tone early in the day.
